subject: Re: POC kickoff stalled — checking priority and next steps

Subject: POC kickoff — next steps & timeline

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time to chat today — I enjoyed learning more about FintechCo's plan to add AI-assisted customer responses into your payments support flow. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment:

Summary of what we discussed:
- Goal: reduce average handle time and increase first-contact resolution for payments-support tickets.
- Success metrics: 25% FCR lift, 30% reduction in average handle time in the pilot segment.
- Data: prioritized support queue + sample logs from May.

Proposed POC scope & timeline:
- Week 0: Redwood provides a short POC playbook + sandbox model and a mutual action plan. (attached: Redwood_POC_Playbook.pdf; Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx)
- Week 1: ingest/sanitize sample data; define evaluation prompts and metrics.
- Week 2-3: run live pilot on a 10% traffic slice; measure metrics and iterate.

Action items for FintechCo:
1) Share SSO user for our onboarding session or list of 2 people to be set up (engineering + support SME).
2) Provide a small sample of de-identified ticket texts (S3 link or Drive).
3) Confirm target start week (we suggested the week of June 29).

I can run the kickoff session and Rafael will be available for escalation/support. If that timeline looks tight, tell me the right week and we'll adjust.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Alex — great, glad the week works. A few quick answers and a proposed kickoff slot:

Firewall / access: typically we ask for a single outbound S3/HTTPS endpoint or a Drive share — no inbound firewall rules needed for the hosted POC. If you plan to run the private deployment path, we'll coordinate with your infra team.

Engineering prep: ideally we get 1) a small sample (~500 messages) de-identified, 2) a list of edge cases to validate, and 3) two logins (engineer + support SME) for the kickoff.

Proposed kickoff: Tuesday, June 30 at 10:00am PT — 45 minutes (onboarding + go/no-go checklist). Please confirm or propose another time.

I've attached the mutual action plan and marked the items for FintechCo to complete before kickoff. If there's any internal procurement step needed, let me know and I can map the dependencies.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Checking in — POC kickoff (no setup yet)

Hi Alex — just bumping this thread. I noticed we haven't received the sample data or confirmed a kickoff time (the June 30 slot passed). Wanted to check whether the POC is still a priority for FintechCo this quarter.

If priorities have shifted, no problem — a quick reply with the new timing helps us rebook resources. If you still want to run the POC but need any help unblocking prep work (data extraction, de-identification, IT coordination), I'm happy to coordinate with your team or schedule a short call with our onboarding engineer.

Next steps I can do from my side:
- Schedule a 30-minute unblock call with your engineer this week.
- Provide a checklist and sample scripts for de-identifying tickets.

Would love a short update — 1-2 lines is fine.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Alex — Rafael here, looping in as Marissa mentioned the kickoff slipped. Wanted to see if we can help move this along:

We can offer three options depending on where you are on prioritization:
1) Quick enable: our onboarding engineer can run the de-id scripts live with your team (30-45 min).
2) Partnered pilot: we can supply a short-term sandbox deployment and a dedicated success manager for the first two weeks.
3) Pause & resume: if this quarter is crowded, we can reserve a kickoff window in Q4 and provide templated onboarding so ramp is faster when ready.

If there are procurement or security approvals blocking you, let us know — we can compress the review items into a one-page checklist and offer an accelerated security call with our compliance team.

Would you be open to a 15-minute sync next week to pick an option? Marissa will coordinate scheduling.

Thanks — Rafael
